sites.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/county/Delaware/Park/Twin-Bridges-Park (read 2026-11-04): 'There are 15 camping sites; 10 with water and electric service and 5 with electric service'; county campground map (2/14/2024): sites 1A-10A 'Water and Electric', 1B-5B 'Electric Only'

hookups.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/county/Delaware/Park/Twin-Bridges-Park (read 2026-11-04): '10 with water and electric service'. Amperage not stated.

facilities.source: https://www.mycountyparks.com/county/Delaware/Park/Twin-Bridges-Park (read 2026-11-04): amenities 'Dump Station', 'Vault Restrooms'; campground map shows the dump station and restrooms

values.note: Electric/water A sites $25 a night, electric-only B sites $20.

fees.source: https://cap.gmdsolutions.com/viewfile.aspx?id=29F9D62DAAD341C1AE24F408442DF95C&dir=Objects (county campground map, last update 2/14/2024, read 2026-11-04): 'Camping Fees All fees are per night per unit. A Sites: Electric and Water - $25.00 B Sites: Electric - $20.00'; https://kmch.com/2026/04/28/delaware-county-campgrounds-open-for-season/ (2026 county notice): 'A Sites – water/electric service – $25 per night', 'B Sites – water service – $20 per night'

values.note: First come, first served: self-register within one hour of placing the camping unit on a site. No unit may occupy a site more than 14 days in any 19-day period. Check-out 4 pm. Shelters are reservable.

booking.source: https://delawarecounty.iowa.gov/conservation/ (Campground Rules and Regulations, read 2026-11-04): 'Camping is on a first come first serve basis – No Reservations - except Youth Group Camping', 'No camping unit shall occupy a campsite more than 14 days out of any 19 day period'; campground map: 'Self-registration must be completed within 1 hour of placing camping unit on campsite. Check-out time is 4:00 pm.'

season.source: https://delawarecounty.iowa.gov/conservation/conservation-parks/ (read 2026-11-04): 'Campgrounds are usually open from mid-April through mid-October.'; mycountyparks: 'Parks with campgrounds are usually open from mid-April through mid-October.'

note: Delaware County Conservation park on Highway 3, 4.5 mi west of Colesburg, with the Elk Creek trout stream running along the south-east side of the campground; the electric-only sites (1B-5B) line the creek side, the water/electric sites sit in a loop under trees. --Claude
summary: County pages, 2024 campground map and 2026 season notice: 15 sites (10 water/electric $25, 5 electric-only $20), dump, vault restrooms, first come first served by self-registration, 14 days in 19, mid-Apr to mid-Oct. Low fee corrected 25 -> 20. Not waterfront kept, with an upward lead on the B sites.
flags: WATERFRONT LEAD (up, unconfirmed): the county campground map (leaf-off base aerial) draws electric-only sites 1B-5B in a row on the creek side of the park drive, ~15-25 m from Elk Creek (~10-13 m wide, so creekside size) across grass with scattered trees and no road between. Summer NAIP and Esri show only canopy over the bank, so the water's edge and any open apron can't be confirmed, and the map is a schematic overlay. Kept not waterfront; a site photo of the B row would settle creekside.
